response.overview: Ingeborg Caspari, a successful businesswoman and matriarch, is getting married at over seventy - for the third time, to a much younger man. To celebrate the occasion, she invites her family to the family estate. Among the guests are her three adult children—Andreas, Philipp, and Katrin—along with their partners and children; even her ex-husband, Henning, doesn’t want to miss the spectacle.
response.title: Die dritte Hochzeit
